description_en: Patukvā Sataḥ 3 is three-storeyed and five-bayed and located on the street that leads from Ikhālakhu in the south to Kvālakhu in the north. No inscription or other documented evidence recording the dates of the Sataḥ's construction or renovation could be found. The cultural and religious activities that used to be organised here seem to have come to an end, and the Sataḥ has been encroached upon by a shop. According to local senior citizens, a Bhairava-mask was traditionally displayed here during the Indrajātrā festival. A Śreṣṭha family from Nyāda Ṭola claims that the Sataḥwas built by their forefathers. This family runs a shop in the Phalcāof this Sataḥand uses the upper floors as store rooms.The ground floor consists of aphalcāwith its bays closed off by doorsand a staircase. Three elaborately carved windows can be seen on the western wall of the first floor, while a more simple wooden window has been installed on its northern wall. Following the earthquakes of 2015, the historicjhingatiroof was dismantled (exact date unclear, likely 2016) and the roof framing and walls were reduced in size, so that they now reach just above the first floor window lintels. The upper structure was then rebuilt using modern brick and cement mortar and raised by approximately 70 cm. Galvanized corrugated metal sheets were used for the new roof and the building received a fresh coat of cement plaster.
description_ne: क्वाल्खु टोलको मूलबाटो छेउमा पश्चिमतिर फर्काई यो सतः बनेको छ । सतःको निर्माण एवं जीर्णोद्धारबारे जानकारी दिने कुनै अभिलेख प्राप्त छैन । भूमि तल्लाको फल्चामा ५ कवलहरु छन् । माथिल्लो तल्लाको मोहोडा भागमा तीनवटा काष्ठ झ्यालहरू छन् जसमध्ये बीचको झ्याल अन्य दुईको तुलनामा ठुलो र बढी बुट्टेदार देखिन्छ । सतःमा हालसालै सिमेन्टको प्रयोग गरी प्लाष्टर भएको र छानाको झिंगटी झिकी जस्तापाटा हालिएको छ । सतःमा हाल कुनै किसिमको धार्मिक एवं सांस्कृतिक गतिविधि हुनेगरेको पाइदैन । फल्चामा विगत इन्द्रजात्राको अवसरमा भैरवको मुखाकृति प्रदर्शनमा राख्ने परम्परा भएको तर पछि यो परम्पराले निरन्तरता पाउन छाडेको भनाई स्थानीयको छ । पाटनको न्याद टोलका एक श्रेष्ठ परिवार आफ्नो पूर्खाले यो सतः बनाएको दाबी गर्छन् । यही परिवारले सतःको फल्चामा पसल र माथिल्लो तल्ला भण्डार कक्षको रुपमा प्रयोग गर्दै को छ ।
monument_assessment: Good (very few light surface damages, renovated or repaired), Repaired
references: REFERENCES Gutschow, Niels, and Bijay Basukala. “Patan. Documentation of Phalchas and Arcaded Ground Floors.” Patan, Nepal, 1990.
